label.en: Receipts from repayment of loans made to other parties (+)

ifrsEnglish: Receipts from repayment of loans made to other parties

note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸列，課程模板沒有；金額不為零時才顯示，並標「模板無此列」。
note.en: An extension line added by the site; the course template has no such line. It is shown only when the amount is non-zero, marked as not in the template.

definition.zh-TW:
以前借給別人的款項收回來時收到的現金。

這是投資活動的流入，是放貸支出的反向：現金增加、短期放款減少。
definition.en:
Cash received when loans previously made to other parties are repaid.

It is an investing inflow and the reverse of loans advanced: cash rises and short-term loans receivable fall.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表投資活動區。本課故事沒有放款，所以用不到。
example.en: Where it sits: the investing activities section of the statement of cash flows. The course story makes no loans, so it is not used.

misconception.zh-TW: 把收回的放款當成收入或營業活動的流入。本金收回只是資產形式的轉換（債權變現金），不是收入；收到的利息才是營業外收入。
misconception.en: Treating the repayment as income or an operating inflow. Collecting the principal merely converts one asset into another (a receivable into cash) and is not income; only the interest received is non-operating income.
